wiki.title: Laura Friedman
wiki.extract: Laura Syril Friedman (born December 3, 1966) is an American politician and former film producer who is the member for California's 30th congressional district in the House of Representatives. A member of the Democratic Party, she previously represented California's 44th State Assembly district from 2016 to 2024.
